content.text:
Resubmitted with the verifier's corrections applied.

**What changed:**
1. **Machine-visible numeral** — § 19.2 now reads "For ninety (90) days after delivery," matching the drafting convention and clearing the deterministic ≥ 90-day period check.
2. **Scoping fix for the latent inconsistency** — the retained cut-off is now "no correction or refund obligation *for that Deliverable*," so it cannot be argued (via § 19.4's reference to "Section 19.1 or 19.2") to extinguish the untimed Services/hosted-software warranty in § 19.1. No new obligation added.
3. **Element mapping restated** — per the software/deliverable boundary in § 1.4 (Deliverables are reports, configurations, designs; Vendor Technology excluded), the "Software … at least 90 days" element is now mapped **already_met** to § 19.1's untimed conformance warranty (Services defined in § 1.7 to include the hosted software), with the operation curing the 15-day extinguishment risk. Services duration and both remedies remain already_met via §§ 19.1 and 19.4.

Minimality holds (single replace), §§ 19.1, 19.3 and 19.4 are untouched, and preferred-level gaps (12-month software period, malicious code narrowed to "intentionally introduced by Vendor") are noted in the rationale rather than redlined.
